rootCauses.summary: GPT-4o open-ended discovery emits, omits, or reframes the same technical topic across otherwise similar runs.
evidence: A-6.00 Phase 2B emitted two Critical locking/fire findings; v8 did not re-emit them (under-emission, not proven fix).
FP200 baseline Critical density×area vs FLOW DEMAND disappeared in later full runs (advisory restatement only).
A-3.06 severity drifted warning → advisory → critical across baseline / Phase 2B / v8.
rootCauses.implication: Persist-time validators can only adjust matching drafts; they cannot restore missing Criticals.

rootCauses.summary: CAD-outlined sheets often lack usable PDF text for height/hardware; Stage 1–2 text packs and Stage 3 Vision packs change what the model can quote.
evidence: Stage 1–2 A-3.06 advisory still claimed look-for did not confirm 3'-6" MIN HEIGHT.
Stage 3 Vision pack associated 3'-6" MIN HEIGHT FROM with GUARD RAIL ELEVATION DETAIL @ HIGH ROOF; model quoted it as positive advisories.
Phase 2B guardrail soft-fail only fires when the draft quotes an applicable height tied to the guardrail detail.
rootCauses.implication: Missing OCR/text association produces unsupported absence claims; recovered OCR must not auto-clear Criticals.

rootCauses.summary: Soft-fail rules are pattern-gated; baseline FP200 Critical was tagged unrelated_discipline rather than hydraulic_density_area_not_flow_demand.
evidence: phase2b-critical-regression.json documents A306-HEIGHT-PROD and A6-*-PROD stay Critical when absence drafts do not quote contradicting evidence.
Hydraulic soft-fail unused when later runs never emit the density×area pattern.
rootCauses.implication: Validators reduce some false positives when emitted; they do not create issue-tracking continuity.

rootCauses.summary: Runs do not share stable technical-check IDs; matching relies on heuristic sheet+topic+token overlap.
evidence: three-run-repeatability-report uses Jaccard topic retention, not professional adjudication.
Title wording changes break naive matching even when the underlying issue is the same.
rootCauses.implication: Deterministic technical-check IDs are required for repeatability independent of GPT titles.

rootCauses.summary: Prompt rules, persist guards, and evidence flags differ across the five runs and amplify emission differences.
evidence: Phase 2B added quote-before-absence prompt guidance and persist soft-fails.
Stage 1–2 temporarily enabled visual evidence globally; Stage 3 used run-scoped Vision packs with Stage 1–2 off.
rootCauses.implication: Separate model variance from prompt/validator/evidence changes when measuring consistency.
